snippet.title: Kusan: City of Wolves - Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
Kusan: City of Wolves delivers relentless top-down action, brutal combat and a pulse-pounding electronic soundtrack. Watch the official Accolades Trailer and see why critics are praising the speed, style and intensity of Kusan’s deadly streets!

Find out more: https://pqube.co.uk/games/kusan-city-of-wolves/
